Class LevelSystem

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.system.LevelSystem
public class LevelSystem extends Object
Manages the level and gravity system for Tetris following standard guidelines.

Rules:

  • Every 10 lines cleared increases level by 1
  • Gravity increases by 1G per level
  • 1G = 1 cell per frame
  • 0.1G = 1 cell per 10 frames
  • At 20G, pieces instantly drop to lock position
